hostname.description: The hostname the balancer answers for, shown under it and in the default description.

requestsPerSecond.description: Total requests per second from users. Each region's counter shows its share of it.

latencyMs.description: Median latency of the primary region while the split is even. The secondary runs 4 ms slower and climbs as it takes the whole load.

speed.description: Multiplies the pace. One outage and recovery cycle takes 21 seconds at 1. 0 holds still.

paused.description: Holds the animation, easing to rest. Paused from the start, it shows the moment traffic shifts away from the unhealthy region.

accent.description: Any CSS color for the requests, lit routes, the weight dial, the split bar and the scrubber. Defaults to the theme accent. Errors and health always use the status colors.

controls.description: Shows the step scrubber with a pause button. Each step is a button that jumps to that stage; arrow keys move between them.

caption.description: Shows the current stage title and one line that narrates it under the scrubber.

label.description: Accessible description. Defaults to a sentence built from the hostname and the region names.

style.description: Inline styles on the root figure.
